text_en: Now before the festival of the Passover, Jesus knew that his hour had come to depart from this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
text_cn: 在逾越节庆日前，耶稣知道他离此世归父的时辰已到，他既然爱了世上属于自己的人，就爱他们到底。

text_en: The devil had already put it into the heart of Judas son of Simon Iscariot to betray him. And during supper
text_cn: 正吃晚餐的时候──魔鬼已使依斯加略人西满的儿子犹达斯决意出卖耶稣──

text_en: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he had come from God and was going to God,
text_cn: 耶稣因知道父把一切已交在他手中，也知道自己是从天主来的，又要往天主那里去，

text_en: got up from the table, took off his outer robe, and tied a towel around himself.
text_cn: 就从席间起来，脱下外衣，拿起一条手巾束在腰间，

text_en: Then he poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was tied around him.
text_cn: 然后把水倒在盆里，开始洗门徒的脚，用束着的手巾擦干。

text_en: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet? ”
text_cn: 及至来到西满伯多禄跟前，伯多禄对他说：“主！你给我洗脚吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “You do not know now what I am doing, but later you will understand. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我所做的，你现在还不明白，但以后你会明白。”

text_en: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet. ” Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no share with me. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄对他说：“不，你永远不可给我洗脚！”耶稣回答说：“我若不洗你，你就与我无分。”

text_en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only but also my hands and my head! ”
text_cn: 西满伯多禄遂说：“主！不但我的脚，而且连手带头，都给我洗罢！”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “One who has bathed does not need to wash, except for the feet, but is entirely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向他说：“沐浴过的人，已全身清洁，只需洗脚就够了。你们原是洁净的，但不都是。”

text_en: For he knew who was to betray him; for this reason he said, “Not all of you are clean. ”
text_cn: 原来，耶稣知道谁要出卖他，为此说：你们不都是洁净的。

text_en: After he had washed their feet, had put on his robe, and had returned to the table, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
text_cn: 及至耶稣洗完了他们的脚，穿上外衣，又去坐下，对他们说：“你们明白我给你们所做的吗？

text_en: You call me Teacher and Lord—and you are right, for that is what I am.
text_cn: 你们称我“师傅”、“主子”，说得正对：我原来是。

text_en: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
text_cn: 若我为主子，为师傅的，给你们洗脚，你们也该彼此洗脚；

text_en: For I have set you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
text_cn: 我给你们立了榜样，叫你们也照我给你们所做的去做。

text_en: Very truly, I tell you, servants are not greater than their master, nor are messengers greater than the one who sent them.
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你们：没有仆人大过主人的，也没有奉使的大过派遣他的。

text_en: If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.
text_cn: 你们既知道了这些事，如果实行，便是有福的。

text_en: I am not speaking of all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But it is to fulfill the scripture, ‘The one who ate my bread has lifted his heel against me. ’
text_cn: 我不是说你们全体，我认识我所拣选的；但经上所记载的必须应验：‘吃过我饭的人，也举脚踢我。’

text_en: I tell you this now, before it occurs, so that when it does occur, you may believe that I am he.
text_cn: 就在现在，事未发生以前，我告诉你们，好叫事发生以后，你们相信我就是那一位。

text_en: Very truly, I tell you, whoever receives one whom I send receives me; and whoever receives me receives him who sent me. ”
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你们：凡接待我所派遣的，就是接待我；接待我的，就是接待那派遣我来的。”

text_en: After saying this Jesus was troubled in spirit, and declared, “Very truly, I tell you, one of you will betray me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说了这些话，心神烦乱，就明明地说：“我实实在在告诉你们：你们中有一个要出卖我。”

text_en: The disciples looked at one another, uncertain of whom he was speaking.
text_cn: 门徒便互相观望，猜疑他说的是谁。

text_en: One of his disciples—the one whom Jesus loved—was reclining next to him;
text_cn: 他门徒中有一个是耶稣所爱的，他那时斜依在耶稣的怀里，

text_en: Simon Peter therefore motioned to him to ask Jesus of whom he was speaking.
text_cn: 西满伯多禄就向他示意说：“你问他说的是谁？”

text_en: So while reclining next to Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it? ”
text_cn: 那位就紧靠在耶稣的胸膛上，问他说：“主！是谁？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish. ” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我蘸这片饼递给谁，谁就是。”耶稣就蘸了一片饼，递给依斯加略人西满的儿子犹达斯。

text_en: After he received the piece of bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus said to him, “Do quickly what you are going to do. ”
text_cn: 随着那片饼，撒殚进入了他的心，于是耶稣对他说：“你所要做的，你快去做罢！”

text_en: Now no one at the table knew why he said this to him.
text_cn: 同席的人谁也没有明白耶稣为什么向他说了这话。

text_en: Some thought that, because Judas had the common purse, Jesus was telling him, “Buy what we need for the festival”; or, that he should give something to the poor.
text_cn: 不过，有人因为犹达斯掌管钱囊，以为耶稣是给他说：“你去买我们过节所需要的，”或者，要他给穷人施舍一些东西。

text_en: So, after receiving the piece of bread, he immediately went out. And it was night.
text_cn: 犹达斯一吃了那一片饼，就立时出去了：那时，正是黑夜。

text_en: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
text_cn: 犹达斯出去以后，耶稣就说：“现在人子受到了光荣，天主也在人子身上受到了光荣。

text_en: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself and will glorify him at once.
text_cn: 天主既然在人子身上得到了光荣，天主也要在自己内使人子得到光荣，并且立时就要光荣他。

text_en: Little children, I am with you only a little longer. You will look for me; and as I said to the Jews so now I say to you, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come. ’
text_cn: 孩子们！我同你们在一起的时候不多了；以后你们要寻找我，就如我曾向犹太人说过：我所去的地方，你们不能去；现在我也给你们说。

text_en: I give you a new commandment, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also should love one another.
text_cn: 我给你们一条新命令：你们该彼此相爱；如同我爱了你们，你们也该照样彼此相爱。

text_en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another. ”
text_cn: 如果你们之间彼此相亲相爱，世人因此就可认出你们是我的门徒。”

text_en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going? ” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow me now; but you will follow afterward. ”
text_cn: 西满伯多禄问耶稣说：“主！你往哪里去？”耶稣回答说：“我所去的地方，你如今不能跟我去，但后来却要跟我去。”

text_en: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for you. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄向他说：“主！为什么现在我不能跟你去？我要为你舍掉我的性命！”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Will you lay down your life for me? Very truly, I tell you, before the cock crows, you will have denied me three times.
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“你要为我舍掉你的性命吗？我实实在在告诉你：鸡未叫以前，你要三次不认我。”
